maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: Single visible keypoint in the uppermost row positioned dorsally and slightly caudal to the first two points of the second dense row.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Melanin saturation is approximately 95-100 percent; the apex of the rhinarium is entirely composed of dark pixels with no visible pink or pale depigmentation.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent mandibular canines with significant yellow-toned dentin exposure; presence of small dipteran insects on the mandibular and labial fur regions.
